passages.text: Collections in Wendmouth take place on weekdays between 06:00 and 16:00. Please put your bins at the edge of your property before the crew arrives and take them back in by the evening. Bins left on the pavement for several days may be removed.

passages.label: S2
passages.title: Wendmouth Waste Services – Customer Charter
passages.text: Collections that fall on a bank holiday move to the following day. A full list of changes is published on our website every December.

passages.label: S3
passages.title: Wendmouth Waste Services – Customer Charter
passages.text: Our crews work on weekdays between 7 am and 4 pm. If your bin has not been emptied by 4 pm on your collection day, please report it online on the next working day and we will return within three working days.

rationale: Both passages end the weekday collection window at 4 pm, but S1 starts it at 06:00 and S3 at 7 am, so the two ranges are incompatible.

question: How long is Hedgehog Hut Nursery closed over Christmas?

passages.label: S1
passages.title: Hedgehog Hut Nursery – Parent Contract
passages.text: Closure periods: the nursery will close for 14 days over the Christmas period, and on bank holidays. Fees are not charged during the Christmas closure.

passages.label: S2

passages.text: The nursery closes for two weeks over Christmas and New Year. It is also closed on all bank holidays. No fees are charged for the Christmas closure.

rationale: Two weeks in S2 and 14 days in S1 are the same closure length, so the passages agree.

question: How many nights can a visiting boat stay at Gullstone Marina?

passages.label: S1
passages.title: Gullstone Marina – Visitor Berths
passages.text: Visiting yachts can stay for a maximum of 14 nights. Please call the marina office on arrival so that we can allocate a berth, and pay before you leave.

passages.label: S2
passages.title: Gullstone Marina – Berth Holder and Visitor Rules
passages.text: Rule 12: Visiting boats may stay for a maximum of 10 nights. Longer stays need a short-term berth contract. Rule 13: Fishing from the pontoons is not allowed.

rationale: S1 allows visitors a maximum of 14 nights and S2 a maximum of 10 nights, for the same visiting boats and with nothing to explain the difference.

question: What ages can join the Lingotrek Academy summer camp?

passages.label: S1
passages.title: Lingotrek Academy – Summer Camp 2026
passages.text: The camp fee includes a room in our residence, all meals, lessons, activities and airport transfers on the main arrival day.

passages.text: Summer camp: in 2026 our residential summer camp welcomes young learners aged 13 to 17. Students are supervised 24 hours a day by our activity staff.

rationale: For the same 2026 camp, S2 gives ages 12–17 and S3 gives 13 to 17, so the ranges agree on the upper age but not the lower one.

question: Do visiting boats need to book a berth at Lowmere Yacht Haven before arriving?

passages.text: All visiting boats must book a berth in advance, either online or by phone. Unbooked boats may be turned away when the marina is full.

passages.label: S2

passages.text: No booking is needed for visitors. Simply arrive, tie up on the hammerhead of pontoon C and walk to the office to be given a berth. Showers and laundry are next to the office.

passages.label: S3
passages.title: Lowmere Yacht Haven – Visitor Tariff Card
passages.text: Visitor rate: £3.10 per metre per night. Short stay (up to 4 hours): £12. Payment by card at the office, which is next to the shower block.

rationale: S1 says visitors must book in advance and S2 says no booking is needed, while S3 only lists prices.

question: What time do morning lessons run at Lingualoom Wendmouth?

passages.text: Dear student, your morning classes start at 9 am and finish at quarter past twelve each weekday. Please arrive a few minutes early on your first day to collect your timetable.

passages.label: S2

rationale: S2's 9:00–12:15 and S1's 9 am to quarter past twelve are the same range written in two ways.

passages.text: For the 2026 season, running from 1 April to 31 October 2026, the overnight visitor rate is £3.50 per metre. Multihulls pay an extra 50%, and electricity is included.

passages.label: S2

passages.text: 2025 season (1 April – 31 October 2025): overnight visitor berths cost £3.20 per metre. Multihulls pay an extra 50%. Electricity is included.

question: What are the fuel pontoon opening hours at Sedgecombe Harbour Marina in summer?

question: What are the weekday opening hours of Mudlark Meadow Nursery?

question: How much does it cost to use the holding-tank pump-out at Mossbury Wharf Marina?

passages.title: Mossbury Wharf Marina – Services for Visiting Boats
passages.text: Visiting boats can use the holding-tank pump-out for £15 per use. Please book at the office; the pump-out is on the fuel pontoon.

question: Must berth holders at Cragmoor Basin show proof of third-party insurance?

question: What is the maximum class size for General English at Corrada Language School?

question: What does a second garden waste bin cost in Sedgecombe?

question: How many free settling-in sessions does Puddlejump Day Nursery offer?

question: Which VHF channel should skippers use to call Tidesend Moorings before entering?

passages.label: S1
passages.title: Tidesend Moorings – Pilotage Notes
passages.text: At low water spring tides, the depth at the entrance can drop to 1.8 metres. Boats with a deeper draught should time their arrival for at least two hours either side of low water.

passages.label: S2
passages.title: Tidesend Moorings – Arrival Procedure
passages.text: Before entering the harbour, call the marina office on VHF channel 80 and give your boat name and length. Wait for berthing instructions; during office hours staff will meet you on the pontoon.

passages.title: Tidesend Moorings – Pilotage Notes
passages.text: The approach channel is marked by red and green buoys. Keep to 4 knots inside the breakwater, and contact the marina on VHF channel 37 before you enter so that a berth can be allocated.

question: How much does a week of tuition cost at Idiomatica Ravelsby?

question: What does Ollerby charge to collect large household items such as sofas?

question: How much is the sibling discount at Conker Corner Nursery, Stowmoor?
